waistReduction.name: Waist reduction (%)
waistReduction.help: The amount by which you want the corset to pinch your waist.

panels.name: Number of panels
panels.help: The number of panels to draft. More panels are better to fit a curvier model.

backOpening.name: Back opening (%)
backOpening.help: Opening at the center back closure.

backRise.name: Back rise (%)
backRise.help: How much the back panels rise from your arms to your center back.

backDrop.name: Back drop (%)
backDrop.help: How much the back panels lower from your hips towards your center back. Negative values will raise the back.

frontRise.name: Front rise (%)
frontRise.help: Rise of the front panels at center front, between your breasts. Negative values will lower them.

frontDrop.name: Front drop (%)
frontDrop.help: How much the front panels lower from your hips towards your center front.

hipRise.name: Hip rise (%)
hipRise.help: How much the side panels rise on your hips.
